paite: Gam vaihawmmi a ding in belamnoute Sela khua gamdai a om a kipan in Zion tanu tang ah khak un.
heading: Lamet Bei Moab Dinmun
english: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

paite: Huchi in vasa abu a kipan dalh a lengleng bang in Arnon lui kainate ah Moab tanute a-om ding uhi.
english: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

paite: Thu hon hilh inla, vai hon hawmsak in; na lim sun lai in zan bang in bawl inla; delhkhiakte sel in; taimangte mansak ke'n.
english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the midst of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

paite: Moab lak a mi delhkhiak a omte na kiang ah om uhen; amau a ding in hihsemi mel a kipan bukna mun hi hen; lepgumi lah bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta ngal a, hihsiatna adaita a, nuaisiahnate gam a kipan hihmanthat in a-omta uhi.
english: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortioner is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

paite: Huchi in laltutphah hehpihna a hihkip in a-om ding a, huai tung ah, David puanin ah, mi khat, vaihawm in, vaihawmna diktat zong in, thil diktat kintak a hihpah in, chihtaktak in atu ding hi.
english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

paite: Moabte kisaktheihna thu, akisathei mahmah uh chih, ka za ua; asuahngaldan uleh, akisaktheihdan uleh, ahehdan thu uh; aki-otsaknate uh bangmah ahi kei hi.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

paite: Huaiziak in Moab tung ah Moab amau tuaituai ding a, michih a mau tuaituai ding; Kir-hareseth grep beu khase tuntun in na kah ding uhi.
english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

paite: Heshbon loute lah atul khinta a, Sibmah grepgui toh, namte toupate'n akung hoih tata akitansak phengphung ua; Jazer kho tanpha in azam ua, gamdai ah azamlut ua; ahiangte azamdalh sengsung ua, tuipi ah azam galkahta uhi.
english: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

paite: Huaiziak in Sibmah grepgui Jazer kah in ka kah ding a; Heshbon leh Elealeh aw, ka khitui in ka hon buak ding; na nipi gahte tung leh na buh tung ah kisual kikou husa aketa ngal a.
english: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

paite: Kipahna laksak in a-omta, lou hoihtak a kipan in leng nopna laksak in a-omta a; grephuan ah lasak himhim a-omta kei ding a, husa nop tuak himhim leng a-om nawn sam kei ding; grep sukna khukte ah chil a sukmi himhim in uain achilkheta kei ding uh; grep la a kikou ka daisakta hi.
english: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

paite: Huaiziak in ka gilte lah Moab hehpihna in pekging bang in aging a, ka gilsung lah Kir-hareseth hehpihna in pekging bang in aging lai hi.
english: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, Moab akilat chiang in mun sang akihihgim a, thum ding a ama Mun Siangthou a ahong pai chiang in avuaksuak ding hi.
english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

paite: Huaite Moab tungthu TOUPA'N tuma a agen ahi.
english: This is the word that Yahweh spoke concerning Moab in time past.

paite: Tu in bel TOUPA'N, kilohmi kum sim a kum thum sung in Moab, thupina, amipi tampitakte nangawn in, muhsithuai a omsak in a-om ding a; akhosuaksunte tawmchik mahmah, gen tham louh ahi ding uh, chi in agenta hi.
english: But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
